name: Proprietary Custodian-Data Platform -- feasibility + build to replace Black Diamond + Orion
description: Andrew-direct 2026-06-23: assess feasibility for (and then build) a proprietary data platform that owns the custodian-aggregation layer ourselves, displacing the Black Diamond + Orion middle tier we currently pay for + integrate against. Thesis (Andrew): BD/Orion just take custodian data + wrap it in UI; we already aggregate custodian data (BD for 49F+Cottonwood, Orion for Inflection, Schwab direct for 49F) + serve it (ADVI portal + MDPF model-feed), and the 3 firms already converge on ONE served contract (platinum/firm/*.json + the ADVI endpoint). So 'replace BD/Orion' = promote the aggregation layer we already operate from a per-firm patchwork into a first-class proprietary platform + go direct-to-custodian where the aggregator adds only UI. New macro DATA stood up to isolate this large research+execution program. PHASE 0 = research/scoping (the PRD frames + scopes the audit); Phase 1 = the broad+deep audit (D1-D6 specs); Phase 2 = the unified data-shape/bucketing architecture; Phase 3 = the MDPF/ADVI input archetype. Likely SmartX partnership for the custodian-aggregation + performance-SoR + model/trade (Eclipse-class) layer. Existing methodologies assessed: 49F (BD, overfit/lots-FIFO), Cottonwood (cot, nascent fork), Inflection (Orion, best-shape snapshot -- the reference). Grounded against a 5-surface live-repo sweep (Schwab/BD/Orion+Eclipse/SmartX/existing-firm-methodologies).

prds.label: CTO formal PRD v0.1 -- premise + strategic thesis (replace the BD/Orion aggregation layer) + current-state ground truth (Schwab/BD/Orion+Eclipse/SmartX/3-firm shapes) + the 3-phase program (audit -> bucketing-architecture -> input-archetype) + D1-D6 Phase-1 deliverables + the unification seam (unify downstream of silver, bronze per-custodian) + the SmartX partnership + feasibility verdict (FEASIBLE, further along than it looks)

phase: PHASE 0 -- RESEARCH/SCOPING. PRD AUTHORED 2026-06-23 (1.0.0_SA_CTO; docs/architecture/DATA_PLATFORM_PRD.md), grounded on a 5-surface live-repo sweep. SEQUENCE: CTO PRD (DONE) -> COO decomposes the Phase-1 audit (D1 Schwab field spec / D2 BD architecture / D3 Orion+Eclipse architecture / D4 SmartX endpoint+structure sweep / D5 unified bucketing architecture / D6 MDPF+ADVI input archetype) -> Phase 2 (build the unified parameterized engine) + Phase 3 (the input archetype) scoped AFTER the audit lands. Feasibility verdict (preliminary): FEASIBLE -- the aggregation + serve layers already exist + are de-facto unified; the genuinely-new work is owned/automated ingest (esp. Schwab) + the Eclipse-class trade/rebalance layer (self-build vs SmartX-partner). No external/third-party gate (Andrew-confirmed); SmartX partnership terms run in parallel.
blocking: None -- PRD landed, Phase-1 audit ready for COO decomposition. Phase-1 deliverables = SPECS (the audit), not builds; Phase 2/3 build against them. Key open architecture decisions deferred to the audit: (1) Schwab ingest automation path (API/SFTP vs scheduled-SI2+auto-sync; currently manual single-firm desktop pull, silver/RPS EMPTY); (2) the Eclipse-class trade/rebalance layer self-build-vs-SmartX-partner; (3) the unification seam (one parameterized gold engine downstream of silver, per-custodian bronze adapters) -- CTO architecture-gates D5/D6.
pipeline: cross-surface custodian-data platform: Schwab (direct, SI2 desktop-pull -> automate) + Black Diamond (DataMining REST, 49F+cot) + Orion+Eclipse (REST, inf) + SmartX (OIDC REST, TAMP partner) -> per-custodian bronze adapters -> ONE unified silver schema (Rule 17) -> ONE firm-parameterized gold engine (capability-declared per FIRM_ID) -> the platinum/firm served contract + the ADVI endpoint + the MDPF model-feed
